errors.evidence: The machine-generated description fails to mention that the chart illustrates percentage values for three different years (2022, 2023, 2024) across months, which is explicitly stated in the reference description.

The description omits the x-axis label (months in Roman numerals I to XII) and the y-axis label (percentage with a range from 0,000 to 140,000 in intervals of 20), both of which are mentioned in the reference.

The description does not mention the grouped bar structure, the color coding for years (blue for 2022, orange for 2023, gray for 2024), or the vertical alignment of bars for easy comparison, all of which are highlighted in the reference.

The description omits key data points such as the highest value (December 2022, exceeding 120,000) and the lowest value (December and July 2023, around 80,000), which are explicitly noted in the reference.
